title: 第7章 任务第8章 念头通达
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
临近初冬，清晨时分，天空中有细细的雪花飘落。
在离外门弟子几百米的树林中，一道身影正在林中修炼。
时而出拳时而出掌，步伐稳健有力。
单晃掌、撩阴掌、双盖掌、平拳、尖拳、透骨拳，一招一式都充满力量。
远远看去，双臂舞动有力且修长，类似猿猴手臂。
修炼接近尾声，林潜一掌拍在大腿粗的树干上。
树没有断，树枝上残留的枯黄叶子犹如雪花般纷纷下扬，以示尊敬。
林潜缓缓呼出一口气，看了看手掌，没有损伤，当然在树干上也没有留下明显的痕迹。
练皮就是把皮肤表面变的坚韧，犹如动物皮肤，保护体内各种组织及器官免受外力侵扰。
没突破练皮之前稍微在那里蹭一下，就破皮了，现在用小刀轻划，都划不破。
林潜调出熟练度面板查看起来。
姓名：林潜
寿命：1460。
武技：通臂拳（二阶80%）。
“快了，最迟半个月就能突破到易筋了。”
林潜露出了微笑。
这一个月林潜提升巨大，通臂拳熟练度提升了46%，除了自己够肝外，每周一次的壮体汤也是功不可没。
每次喝下壮体汤，随着壮体汤的药效发挥，让林潜全身都暖洋洋的，在这种状态下，他修炼起通臂拳来事半功倍。
通臂拳的修炼进度自然也增长的快。
壮体汤的效果很好。

林潜从药堂的人打听到，一碗壮体汤要两百铜板，这还是宗门内的价格。
要是在外面，这一碗壮体汤足足要五百铜币。
听得林潜一阵咂舌，这简直就是暴利啊。
这个月林潜除了修炼通臂拳。
同时还锻炼了耐力和力量，训练的方法当然是来自林潜前世在健身房学的方法。
器材都是他借的工具自己做的，简陋是简陋了点，但是可以用。
现在林潜能轻松提起四百斤的石锁。
“明天就要开始做宗门任务了，希望一切顺利。”
林潜自语道。
来苍云门一年多了，在林潜还是杂役时，就从旁人的交谈中了解到，这个世界并不太平。
谋财害命，半路抢劫，都是常有的事。
就算是苍云门弟子，每年都有人伤亡。
......
翌日早晨，凛冬的阳光有些寒意。
演武场上站着密密麻麻的弟子，这些都是外门弟子，大概有上百号人，他们都是来领这个月的任务的，林潜也在其中。
不一会，事务堂执事来了，站在高台上，拿出名册，开始给台下的众人布置任务。
任务五花八门，各种各样，有困难的也有简单的。
有给富商当护卫的任务；有给去商队当护卫，保护货物免遭贼匪抢劫；有进深山采药的任务；采购任务；运送宗门货物任务；还有缉拿罪犯任务等等。
这些任务大多数都有一定的风险，但是身为最底层的人，是没有拒绝的权利的。
content_en:
Early winter is approaching, and in the early morning, fine snowflakes are falling from the sky.
In the woods a few hundred meters away from the outer disciples, a figure was practicing in the woods.
Sometimes he punches and sometimes he palms, and his steps are steady and powerful.
Single shaking palm, teasing palm, double covering palm, flat fist, sharp fist, bone penetrating fist, every move is full of power.
Seen from a distance, the arms dance powerfully and slenderly, resembling ape arms.
As the practice came to an end, Lin Qian slapped his palm on the tree trunk as thick as his thigh.
The tree was not broken, and the remaining yellow leaves on the branches fell like snowflakes to show respect.
Lin Qian exhaled slowly and looked at his palm. There was no damage, and of course there were no obvious marks on the trunk.
Skin training is to make the surface of the skin tough, like animal skin, to protect various tissues and organs in the body from external forces.
Before the breakthrough and skin training, the skin was broken if I rubbed it there a little bit. Now I can't even scratch it with a knife.
Lin Qian brought up the proficiency panel and checked it.
Name: Lin Qian
Lifespan: 1460.
Martial skills: Arm-Through Fist (Level 2 80%).
"It's coming soon. I'll be able to break through to Yijin in half a month at the latest."
Lin Qian smiled.
Lin Qian has made great progress this month, and his proficiency in Tongjiquan has increased by 46%. In addition to his own liver, the weekly body-building soup also plays an important role.
Every time he drank the body-building soup, Lin Qian's whole body felt warm as the medicinal effects of the body-building soup took effect. In this state, he practiced Tongjiquan to get twice the result with half the effort.
The progress of Tongjiquan training has naturally increased rapidly.
Bodybuilding soup works great.
Lin Qian inquired from people in the medicine hall that a bowl of body-building soup costs two hundred copper coins, which is still the price within the sect.
If you were outside, this bowl of body-building soup would cost five hundred copper coins.
Lin Qian clicked his tongue for a while, this was simply a huge profit.
This month, Lin Qian besides practicing Tongjiquan.
At the same time, he also exercised his endurance and strength. The training method was of course the method that Lin Qian learned in the gym in his previous life.
The equipment was all made by himself with the tools he borrowed. It was a bit crude, but it was usable.
Now Lin Qianqian could easily lift the four hundred kilogram stone lock.
"The sect mission will begin tomorrow. I hope everything goes well."
Lin Qian said to himself.
I have been coming to Cangyunmen for more than a year. When Lin Qian was still a handyman, he learned from the conversations of others that the world was not peaceful.
Seeking money, killing people, and robbing people along the way are common occurrences.
Even among the disciples of the Cangyun Sect, there are casualties every year.
...
The next morning, the winter sunshine was a bit chilly.
There were densely packed disciples standing on the martial arts field. These were all outer disciples, about a hundred of them. They were all here to take on this month's mission, and Lin Qian was among them.
After a while, the deacon of the affairs hall came, stood on the high platform, took out the roster, and began to assign tasks to everyone in the audience.
The tasks are diverse and varied, some are difficult and some are easy.
There are missions to serve as guards for wealthy businessmen; there are missions to serve as guards for caravans to protect goods from bandits; there are missions to go into the mountains to collect herbs; there are procurement missions; there are missions to transport sect goods; there are also missions to apprehend criminals, etc.
Most of these tasks involve certain risks, but as the lowest level person, you have no right to refuse.
